description: This file defines an abstract assertion class for `Jsonifiable` objects, providing custom validation methods such as JSON string comparison and schema version checks, used in testing scenarios within the project.

classes.name: AbstractJsonifiableAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for `Jsonifiable` objects, providing methods to validate JSON string outputs and schema version support.

methods.name: hasJsonString
methods.description: Checks if the `Jsonifiable` object's JSON string matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasLatestSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the `Jsonifiable` object's latest schema version matches the expected version.

methods.name: supportSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the `Jsonifiable` object supports specific schema versions.

methods.name: implementsSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the `Jsonifiable` object implements a specific schema version.
